label: Mandatory Incident Reporting
description: Reports of crashes or other safety incidents submitted to an authority.

label: Regular reports
description: Recurring safety or operating reports, such as monthly or annual submissions.

label: Mandatory VMT Reporting
description: Reported mileage or other operating-activity information used to understand exposure.

label: Stored event data
description: Requirements to record or retain data about safety events. This does not necessarily mean submitting a report.

label: Authority access
description: Authorities can obtain company or vehicle data, including on request.

label: Public / Research Access
description: A route to published reports or public/research access. This does not necessarily mean an open crash database.

label: Reporting deadlines
description: A specified time limit for submitting a report.

label: Permit conditions
description: Requirements depend on the particular testing permit or operating approval.

label: EU approval rules
description: The shared EU manufacturer-reporting framework applies when the vehicle uses the covered approval route.

label: Open Data
description: AV safety or operating data are openly available for public download. Reports obtainable only by request, confidential research access and public summaries are shown separately in country details.

label: AVs Authorized
description: A legal route permits AV testing or operation, subject to approval and operating conditions. This does not mean every AV company is authorized or unrestricted driverless service is allowed.
